mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.couple_id, m.from_id, m.to_id, m.content, m.is_read, m.created_at, fu.nickname AS from_name, tu.nickname AS to_name FROM message m LEFT JOIN user fu ON m.from_id = fu.id LEFT JOIN user tu ON m.to_id = tu.id WHERE m.couple_id = #{coupleId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC

SELECT m.id, m.couple_id, m.from_id, m.to_id, m.content, m.is_read, m.created_at, fu.nickname AS from_name, tu.nickname AS to_name FROM message m LEFT JOIN user fu ON m.from_id = fu.id LEFT JOIN user tu ON m.to_id = tu.id WHERE m.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (couple_id, from_id, to_id, content, is_read) VALUES (#{coupleId}, #{fromId}, #{toId}, #{content}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND to_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM message WHERE id = #{id} AND from_id = #{userId}
